component.name: VoiceTerm
component.summary: Terminal with voice control and split panes

description.p: VoiceTerm is a terminal you can drive by voice, with a pane split-tree, an integrated reader and mail.

ul.li: Dictation with whisper hallucination filtering, at a strength you choose
Pane split-tree and native tabs, navigable by voice
Web panes that surface the actions on a page rather than only rendering it
